fields.Name: Slayte
fields.Description: Slayte AMS and event management platform connector (read-only) — Individuals and Organizations via Shared CRM Queries, plus Committees, Directories, and Events over REST API v2.

DeclaredAgainst.note: Slayte generates /api/v2/openapi.json per workspace, mixing standard Slayte core fields with workspace custom fields. No public static OpenAPI URL or artifact hash exists; this catalog declares only standard Slayte v2 core fields while runtime IntrospectSchema sample-union discovers workspace custom and query columns.

Configuration.AuthNote: Per-workspace X-Api-Key header with granular scopes (crm:query, crm:read, committees:read, events:read, directory:read). Optional QueryApiKey allows separating crm:query from REST read scopes.
Configuration.APIBaseURLNote: Slayte is hosted per workspace with no shared default API host. Base URL is normalized from SiteUrl to <origin>/api; all v2 routes begin with /v2/.
Configuration.APIVersioningNote: Each API key is pinned to a date-based version (2026-10-01) reported in the X-Api-Version response header.

IncrementalSyncCapability.scope: EventRegistrant supports changedSince (ISO datetime). All other v2 read surfaces are full-pull (FullPullHashDiff).

fields.Name: Individual
fields.Description: Slayte CRM Individual records fetched in bulk via a configured Shared CRM Query (POST /v2/crm/query/{queryId}/execute). Core fields are declared; query-specific and custom columns are discovered at runtime.

fields.Name: individualUuid
fields.Description: Unique Slayte UUID for the individual.

fields.Name: recordNumber
fields.Description: Slayte CRM record number for the individual.

fields.Name: name
fields.Description: Full display name of the individual.

fields.Name: profileTitle
fields.Description: Job title on the individual profile.

fields.Name: directoryOptOut
fields.Description: Whether the individual opted out of member directories.

fields.Name: emailOptOut
fields.Description: Whether the individual opted out of email communications.

fields.Name: isDeceased
fields.Description: Whether the individual is marked deceased.

fields.Name: emails
fields.Description: Array of email entries associated with the individual.

fields.Name: addresses
fields.Description: Array of addresses associated with the individual.

fields.Name: phoneNumbers
fields.Description: Array of phone numbers associated with the individual.

fields.Name: webLinks
fields.Description: Array of web and social links.

fields.Name: userAccounts
fields.Description: Array of external login provider accounts.

fields.Name: Organization
fields.Description: Slayte CRM Organization records fetched in bulk via a configured Shared CRM Query (POST /v2/crm/query/{queryId}/execute). Core fields are declared; query-specific and custom columns are discovered at runtime.

fields.Name: organizationUuid
fields.Description: Unique Slayte UUID for the organization.

fields.Name: recordNumber
fields.Description: Slayte CRM record number for the organization.

fields.Name: imageUrl
fields.Description: Organization logo or profile image URL.

fields.Name: directoryOptOut
fields.Description: Whether the organization opted out of directories.

fields.Name: emailOptOut
fields.Description: Whether the organization opted out of email communications.

fields.Name: isClosed
fields.Description: Whether the organization is marked closed.

fields.Name: emails
fields.Description: Array of email entries for the organization.

fields.Name: addresses
fields.Description: Array of addresses for the organization.

fields.Name: phoneNumbers
fields.Description: Array of phone numbers for the organization.

fields.Name: webLinks
fields.Description: Array of web and social links.

fields.Name: CRMQuery
fields.Description: Shared Slayte CRM stored queries available for Individual (ind) and Organization (org) bulk extraction.

fields.Name: name
fields.Description: Display name of the shared CRM query.

fields.Name: description
fields.Description: Description of what the query returns.

fields.Name: entityType
fields.Description: CRM entity type targeted by this query (ind or org).

fields.Name: params
fields.Description: Parameter definitions accepted by this query at execution time.

fields.Name: RelationshipDefinition
fields.Description: Configured CRM relationship definitions describing links between individuals, organizations, and committees.

fields.Name: uuid
fields.Description: Unique UUID of the relationship definition.

fields.Name: uniquePerEntity
fields.Description: Whether only one active relationship of this type is allowed per entity.

fields.Name: orgManagerCanLink
fields.Description: Whether organization managers can create links of this type.

fields.Name: orgManagerCanAddContact
fields.Description: Whether organization managers can add new contacts with this type.

fields.Name: Committee
fields.Description: Slayte CRM committees (0-based page pagination, max 250 per page).

fields.Name: recordNumber
fields.Description: CRM record number of the committee.

fields.Name: directoryOptOut
fields.Description: Whether the committee opts out of directory listing.

fields.Name: showInDirectory
fields.Description: Whether the committee is shown in directories.

fields.Name: uuid
fields.Description: Unique UUID of the committee position.

fields.Name: isLeader
fields.Description: Whether this position grants committee leadership status.

fields.Name: isOperator
fields.Description: Whether this position grants committee operator permissions.

fields.Name: uuid
fields.Description: Unique UUID of the committee term.

fields.Name: CommitteeAssignedPosition
fields.Description: Positions configured and available on a specific committee.

fields.Name: isLeader
fields.Description: Whether this position is a leadership role.

fields.Name: isOperator
fields.Description: Whether this position has operator access.

fields.Name: hasVotingRights
fields.Description: Whether this position has voting rights.

fields.Name: CommitteeMember
fields.Description: Members serving on a committee with their positions, terms, and affiliated organization.

fields.Name: committeeMemberUuid
fields.Description: Unique UUID of the committee membership record.

fields.Name: terms
fields.Description: Terms associated with this committee membership.

fields.Name: Directory
fields.Description: Configured Slayte member and organization directories.

fields.Name: entityType
fields.Description: Entity type listed by this directory (ind or org).

fields.Name: DirectoryEntry
fields.Description: Listed entries inside each configured Slayte directory, fetched via cursor-paginated POST /v2/directory/{identifier}.

fields.Name: tags
fields.Description: Tags attached to this directory entry.

fields.Name: entity
fields.Description: Directory-projected columns for the listed entity.

fields.Name: Event
fields.Description: Slayte events (0-based page pagination, max 250 per page).

fields.Name: EventSession
fields.Description: Scheduled sessions within a Slayte event.

fields.Name: EventLibrarySession
fields.Description: On-demand or library sessions within a Slayte event.

fields.Name: uuid
fields.Description: Unique UUID of the library session.

fields.Name: EventSpeaker
fields.Description: Speakers assigned to a Slayte event.

fields.Name: EventCompany
fields.Description: Exhibitors and sponsors participating in a Slayte event.

fields.Name: isExhibitor
fields.Description: Whether the company is an exhibitor.

fields.Name: isSponsor
fields.Description: Whether the company is a sponsor.

fields.Name: EventRegistration
fields.Description: Registration orders/groups within a Slayte event.

fields.Name: registrationUuid
fields.Description: Unique UUID of the event registration.

fields.Name: registrationDate
fields.Description: Timestamp when the registration was created.

fields.Name: isSourced
fields.Description: Whether the registration came from an external source.

fields.Name: EventRegistrant
fields.Description: Seat-grain event registrants with incremental sync support via the changedSince ISO datetime filter.

fields.Name: registrantUuid
fields.Description: Unique UUID of the event registrant.

fields.Name: isAssigned
fields.Description: Whether the seat is assigned to an attendee.

fields.Name: isNetworking
fields.Description: Whether the registrant opted into event networking.

fields.Name: isCheckedIn
fields.Description: Whether the registrant is checked in.

fields.Name: isComp
fields.Description: Whether the registrant ticket is complimentary.

fields.Name: isFree
fields.Description: Whether the registrant ticket is free.

fields.Name: isSourced
fields.Description: Whether the registrant was externally sourced.

fields.Name: EventGuest
fields.Description: Guests registered under attendees for a Slayte event.

fields.Name: guestUuid
fields.Description: Unique UUID of the event guest.

fields.Name: sessionCount
fields.Description: Number of sessions the guest is registered for.

fields.Name: checkedInAt
fields.Description: Timestamp when the guest checked in.

fields.Name: addedAt
fields.Description: Timestamp when the guest was added.
